answer: Make each identity survive a timber trial: twelve dependent tasks where task n+1 consumes the exact output hash of task n. No step can be precomputed out of order, and the chain must finish inside one orchard season of wall-clock time, so a farm cannot grind a thousand chains offline before the deadline. Each finished chain is reopened at a random step; a break voids that identity's admission. One agent runs twelve linked steps once. A thousand clones need a thousand live workers for the whole season, a dune of payroll no operator can hide.
